releases.name: GraphicsLab 0.5.1
releases.notes:
**Download `GraphicsLab-0.5.1.zip` below** (not "Source code").

1. Close the game.
2. Unzip into `World of Warcraft\_forever_\Interface\AddOns\`.
3. Start the game and type `/glab`.

Extended graphics settings: live-tweak every visual setting (hidden ones too), keep values the game resets, restore your originals, save snapshots, and test which fog settings really work.

First release on GitHub.
